name: Push-Up to Side Plank
instructions: Get into push-up position on your toes with your hands just outside shoulder width.
Perform a push-up by allowing the elbows to flex, keeping your body straight as you descend.
As you come up, shift your weight onto one side and twist into a side plank, reaching that arm up toward the ceiling.
Lower the arm back to the floor for another push-up, then twist to the other side.
Repeat the series, alternating sides, for the recommended amount of repetitions.
